svg.title: Technologien bei BW.Tech
svg.desc: Sprachen: PHP, JavaScript, C++, Kotlin, Swift, Vue, Java, Objective-C, C#, Python, CMake, PowerShell, Shell. Plattform und Standards: WebDAV, CalDAV, CardDAV, S3 Object Storage, LDAP, OpenID Connect, OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0, 2FA (TOTP), SMB/CIFS, Kerberos, Virenscan (ICAP), AES-256-Verschlüsselung, Brute-Force-Schutz, Audit-Log (SIEM), Barrierefreiheit.
